identity.title: [v0.92][migration] Migrate pre-topology bound issue records to Git topology

values.goal: Migrate every pre-#5886 bound record with incomplete topology into truthful current C-SDLC v2 state.
values.required_outcome: All affected records receive a deterministic disposition and open never-bound issues become normally bindable without restoring claims.
declared_scope: One typed migration operation under the current csdlc-issue owner
Per-issue disposition evidence and focused regression tests
authority_boundary: Canonical .csdlc issue records and verified Git worktree topology
Explicit live GitHub issue-state snapshot supplied as typed input
operator_constraints: Treat this as state migration, not tooling reliability work
Do not restore claims, leases, heartbeats, or preparation state
Do not hand-edit canonical issue records
